actions.name: Process resource snapshot
actions.command: Get-Process | Sort-Object CPU -Descending | Select-Object -First 30 Name,Id,CPU,WorkingSet64,Handles | Format-Table -AutoSize

actions.name: Process and startup inventory

actions.name: Devices with reported faults

actions.name: Hardware and operating system inventory
